title: Microsoft 365 Backup: Teams channel backup and recovery
summary: The briefing passes: its roadmap facts and existing-workload pricing are supported, and Teams-specific controls, roles and pricing remain undocumented. The control paths need minor completion, and the SharePoint API note should name its request-body property. The updated Microsoft guidance adds Entra backup information but does not document Teams channel backup.
